fix.summary: Apply one forward Recorder failure-boundary closure: prove labels before use, retain safe causes without catch-and-continue, reject all environment lexical defects structurally, and close the shipped failure schema.

details.note:
Adjudicated every Review-007 Must at target `37ec52f23ffd0091d3a79c1cef26fd15a44fb63a`; Recorder product remains `f979c3ed3cdf47e3c63209612875998bce0a1601`. No owner decision or new Fixer Plan is required.

## Finding dispositions

1. **Standards Must — launcher laundering: sustained.** `bin/ak-docket-record.js` maps entry-access failure and actual launcher spawn failure to the same cause-less `spawn-failed`. Entry unavailability does not prove a spawn failure. Both catches discard the only safe cause evidence. Actual synchronous and asynchronous launcher-spawn failures are the only lawful launcher uses of `spawn-failed`; package-entry failure must be fixed-message `internal-error`. Child truth remains `not-spawned`.

2. **Standards Must — destination probing/collision: sustained.** `destinationOccupied()` returns occupied after every non-`ENOENT` `lstatSync` failure. The preflight caller therefore emits cause-less `destination-exists` without proving occupancy. Promotion also catches a rename cause and discards it when either its native predicate or a second probe reports occupancy. Occupancy is proved only by successful `lstat` or the finite no-replace collision predicate; absence is proved only by `ENOENT`. Other failures must retain their cause and must not become occupancy.

3. **Standards Must — containment catch-and-continue: sustained as one containment-owner class.** `assertPathNotSymlinkEscape()` suppresses failed `lstat`/`realpath` truth and continues to parents; `assertScratchOutsideOrIgnored()` substitutes lexical `resolve()` after failed `realpath`. The same owner also catch-alls `git check-ignore`: only its documented not-ignored outcome is a policy negative; launch, permission, malformed-repository, and other command failures are not. A race yielding `ENOENT` may be handled explicitly as absence and continue to the existing-parent proof. Every other containment failure must fail closed with a safe cause. Proven escape/not-ignored predicates may retain `invalid-path`; unknowns may not borrow it.

4. **Standards Must — permissive Git admission: sustained.** `isCommittedInContainingRepo()` turns failure of either Git command into `false`, so missing/unexecutable Git, permissions, and repository/process faults are treated as “not committed” and admission continues. Only machine-established “no containing repository” and “path not tracked” outcomes are lawful negatives. A tracked source remains rejected; an untracked source remains admissible. Unexpected failures must stop admission with a retained safe cause under a truthful admission/internal classification. Do not infer status by regex over Git prose.

5. **Spec Must — incomplete caught-owner honesty: sustained and merged into dispositions 1–4.** It is the same defect class, not a fifth implementation mechanism. Specific labels require owner predicates; caught causes must reach the fixed public object as allow-listed stage/category evidence. In particular, retain the rename collision cause even when collision is proved. Predicate failures that did not catch an exception need not invent a cause.

6. **Spec Must — environment lexical defects: sustained as the complete v1 environment lexical boundary.** The structural parser accepts NUL in override names, override values, and unset names; all three were independently confirmed accepted, while Node rejects NUL at spawn. On supported darwin/linux, environment names must be nonempty and contain neither NUL nor `=` (which changes the name/value boundary), and values must not contain NUL. Reject override-name/value defects at `['execution','environment','overrides']` without exposing the attacker-controlled key; reject unset-name defects at `['execution','environment','unset',index]`. These checks belong in `parseRecorderConfigStructure`, before metadata scanning, state/filesystem/Git work, stage allocation, admission, or spawn. Preserve environment values as unscanned child credentials and preserve inherited-or-empty → unset → override semantics.

7. **Spec Must — open shipped failure schema: sustained.** The current schema accepts a fabricated message, twenty arbitrary location segments, and signal `SIGMADEUP` in one object; this was mechanically reproduced. Bounded strings are not a closed wire contract. Close code/message pairs to the fixed runtime mapping; make `invalid-config` locations follow the finite v1 path grammar (root or actual field/container/index shapes, maximum four segments, bounded nonnegative runtime array indices) and all other locations null; add a finite supported darwin/linux signal vocabulary and runtime-valid exit-code bounds; preserve exact not-spawned/exited/signaled nullability and diagnostic combinations; require a diagnostic for `internal-error`; and keep code, message, stage, category, location, signal, TypeScript, launcher, runtime, and schema vocabularies synchronized.

The current focused failure/config tests pass 16/16 and typecheck passes, but those tests do not exercise these counterexamples and therefore do not rebut them.

## Authorized single forward Apply packet

- **Failure owners (`errors.ts`, launcher, `run.ts`, `paths.ts`, `admit.ts`):** add one truthful finite `launcher` stage; emit a sanitized diagnostic from launcher entry/spawn causes without interpolating message, stack, path, argv, or environment. Keep the launcher’s dist-unavailable fallback minimal and schema-tested rather than adding a second general failure system. Replace boolean destination probing with proved occupied/absent/error outcomes. Classify promotion collision only from the native occupied predicate (or successful occupancy observation), retaining the caught rename cause; otherwise emit retained-cause `promotion-failed`/`internal-error`. Replace containment suppression/lexical fallback with explicit `ENOENT` handling and fail-closed propagation. Split Git admission’s two expected negatives from command/repository failures using typed status/protocol facts, never prose.
- **Config owner (`config.ts`):** implement the complete environment-name/value lexical rules above in the existing pure structural pass with the exact safe locations. Do not move or duplicate scanners and do not add stateful validation to structure.
- **Wire owner (`errors.ts`, `schemas/recorder-failure-v1.schema.json`, README only if its contract text needs synchronization):** expose closed constants/types for fixed messages, location segments/path grammar, and supported signals; encode coherent combinations in the shipped schema. Do not make failure emission depend on reading the schema at runtime.
- **Regression proof:** add class tables, not one-off probes. Through production seams, prove launcher missing-entry versus spawn failure, destination success/`ENOENT`/unexpected error, known collision versus unknown rename failure, containment `ENOENT` versus realpath/lstat/Git failure, and Git no-repo/untracked versus missing/failed Git. Assert truthful code/stage/category, retained safe cause, fixed message, no secret leakage, exact child truth, no spawn/publication on pre-spawn failure, and unchanged collision safety. Add override-name/value and unset-name NUL cases plus empty/`=` names, with exact locations and structural-before-scanner/state/spawn ordering. Add schema rejection matrices for wrong code/message pair, unlawful/overlong locations and indices, unknown signals, invalid exit/status/signal/diagnostic combinations, while validating actual launcher and Recorder emissions. Use real seams or production-owned refactoring; no test-only production hook or permanent probe.
- Regenerate `dist/recorder/*`; run focused Recorder tests, full `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build:recorder`, `npm pack --dry-run`, schema/package checks, `git diff --check`, source/dist consistency, and residue checks.

## Frozen scope

Preserve fixed sanitized public output, scanner boundaries, complete structural-before-stateful ordering, one common all-command Recorder path, exact child settlement/tee truth, admission and scanning semantics, same-filesystem atomic no-replace publication, and retained-snapshot/manual-cleanup owner policy. The historical swallowed exception, original invocation, Recorder-entry timing, and approximately 920-second cause remain indeterminate and must not be claimed. Issue #13 retry/recurrence/routing behavior remains excluded.
